python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as s:
 s.settimeout(3); s.connect('/run/lcnode/imperium/control.sock'); s.sendall(b'vpn lightcone status\n'); data=b''
 while not data.endswith(b'\n'):
  part=s.recv(65536)
  if not part: break
  data+=part
 print(data.decode())
PY
